215: Cortech Sequoia Molded Wood Grain Nightstand
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-215-sequoia-molded-wood-grain-night-stand
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/endurance/sequoia-series-beds/sequoia-molded-wood-grain-nightstand/
Spec sheets: 215, Installation
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Sequoia Molded Wood Grain Nightstand – 215
Current H1: Cortech Sequoia - Night Stand with Wood‑Grain Finish - One‑Piece Molded Construction - Model 215
Subtitle: One-Piece Molded Nightstand with a Wood Grain Finish and Rounded Edges, to Match the Sequoia Bed
Current subtitle: Cortech 215 Sequoia Night Stand with Molded Wood Grain Finish for Behavioral Health Care Facilities
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Sequoia Molded Wood Grain Nightstand is a one-piece molded nightstand with a wood grain finish, for patient rooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and other secure settings. It matches the Sequoia Bed for a warm, residential room.
The nightstand is rotationally molded as a single unit from high impact polyethylene, with no metal or wood components, and its rounded edges and sloped surfaces help reduce ligature risk. It bolts to the floor.
Material: One-piece rotationally molded high impact polyethylene; no metal or wood components
Dimensions: 18”W×16”D×21”H
Weight: 26 lbs
Safety: Rounded edges and sloped surfaces help reduce ligature risk
Floor Mounting: Bolts to the floor
Finishes: Heritage Oak, Natural Oak, Coastal Driftwood, Walnut, or Redwood wood grain (custom wood grain finishes available on request)
Wood Grain: Like natural wood, each piece varies slightly in color and grain
Antimicrobial: Infused with CORx antimicrobial compound
Flammability Standards: Flame retardant; passes California Technical Bulletin 133
Award: The Sequoia Series earned a 2025 Gold Nightingale Award in the Anti-Ligature and Reduced-Ligature Furnishings category
Warranty: Lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
215 – Sequoia Nightstand: Heritage Oak, Natural Oak, Coastal Driftwood, Walnut, or Redwood
Installation and Options
Floor Mounting: Bolt to the floor through four holes drilled through the nightstand; see Cortech instructions
[H2] Applications
The Sequoia Nightstand suits patient rooms that want a warm, residential look to match the Sequoia Bed.
Typical applications include:
Patient rooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Residential treatment centers and secure treatment programs
Other secure settings that want a residential bedroom
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture collection for more patient room furniture.
[H2] About Cortech Beds
Cortech beds are rotationally molded in one piece for patient rooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and cells in correctional facilities, where beds must be safe, strong, and easy to clean.
Cortech beds include:
Solstice Series: The Solstice Bed, and the Solstice Safeguard Bed with raised side panels for fall-risk patients
Sequoia Series: Molded beds and night stands with a wood grain finish
Endurance Series: Endurance beds, wall mounted bunks, and EZ Bunk stackable temporary sleep surfaces
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (63 characters): Cortech Sequoia Molded Wood Grain Nightstand - 215 at Anchortex
Meta description (158 characters): Shop the Cortech Sequoia Nightstand. A one-piece molded nightstand with a wood grain finish and rounded edges, made to match the Sequoia Bed in patient rooms.
Notes and Questions
Series section: "About Cortech Beds" is a new section for the Solstice and Sequoia bed pages. It is the same on each of these pages.
H1: Cortech calls it the Sequoia Molded Wood Grain Nightstand. I used that and took out the extra words.
Weight: your variant is set to 29 lbs. The Cortech spec sheet says 26 lbs, so I used 26 lbs.
Variant name: your variant says "215 - Sequoia Night Standard." Would you like it renamed "215 - Sequoia Nightstand"?
Dimensions: the Cortech spec sheet lists 21”H×18”W×16”D, but the drawing on the second page shows about 21.5”, 17.5”, and 22”. I used the listed size.
Ballast doors: the second page of the Cortech spec sheet lists "Options: Ballast doors," but the first page does not, and there is no ballast model. I left it out.
Floor mounting hardware: the Cortech spec sheet says "hardware of your choice," but the installation instructions list four tamper-resistant Torx screws and washers as included. I left the hardware out of the description. Can you check with Cortech?
Finishes: your current page lists four finishes. The Cortech spec sheet also lists Redwood (215RW), so I added it. Your variant has no finish option. How do customers choose a finish?
Collection link: the nightstand is only in your Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture collection, so I linked that one.
I left out GREENGUARD Gold, UL 94 HB, and "Patent Pending," since the Cortech spec sheet does not say these.
Product images: the page has five images, including a Sequoia finish chart. The Cortech product page has a Redwood nightstand photo. Would you like me to add it?
